did.unittitle: Paul Ehrlich papers, Beate I. Hirsch Research Files

physdesc.extent: 3 record storage boxes, 1 oversize box and 1 legal document box

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Level 1: File-Level access. Some materials remain in original housing.
Initial processing conducted by Lee R. Hiltzik, 1994 April 28.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: A special collection of the Rockefeller University.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Consists of the research files of Beate I. Hirsch, appointed to arrange the Paul Ehrlich papers together with her husband, Dr. James Hirsch. Includes articles, biographical sketches, publications and photocopies of publications, private papers of Gunther Schwerin, correspondence and personal files.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Original order, as received. Intellectually arranged in series by record type.
